verdict.rationale: Snowflake's docs describe native dbt Projects on Snowflake covering the full dbt lifecycle (develop, deploy, orchestrate, observe), with managed dbt Core and dbt Fusion runtimes and a migration guide from dbt Core. A community comment shows dbt models in real use on Snowflake, though it notes thin guidance on clustering for full-refresh models. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the native dbt Projects feature itself (the community evidence speaks only to dbt usage generally).
